title: Loi n°2025-019 relative à l'évaluation environnementale et sociale
citation: Loi n° 2025-019/P.R du 2 juin 2025 relative à l'évaluation environnementale et sociale, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1585 du 15 juillet 2025, p. 619
evidence: No official page states an entry-into-force date: Art. 45 reads "La présente loi sera exécutée comme loi d'Etat et publiée au Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie." and the text has no commencement clause. The law is signed "Fait à Nouakchott, le 02 juin 2025"; the portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2025-1585 du 15/07/2025" (https://msgg.gov.mr/fr/droit-mauritanien/le-journal-officiel.html, opened 2026-11-03). The record is dated the gazette date, 2025-07-15, as the date of the published text; this is not a stated entry into force.
notes: Mapped to F2 (the existing register row said F7): the act sets the environmental and social assessment regime for projects, plans and programmes; it is not a climate or reporting duty. Art. 44 repeals prior contrary provisions, 'notamment' Loi n° 2000-045 (mr-loi-2000-045), and keeps Décret n° 2004-094 and Décret n° 2007-105 (mr-decret-2004-094, mr-decret-2007-105) in force until the implementing decree of this law is adopted; no such decree was found on the portal on 2026-11-03. Two records (fr, ar): French text of the gazette issue, cut from page 3 (title) to the signatures (pdftotext in two column crops per page, running headers and bare page numbers dropped). Arabic (the official language): the Arabic gazette issue is served at https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2025/mauritanie-jo-2025-1585-ar.pdf. The Arabic text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack ara from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 3 to 9, from the title of the law to the last signature line (the Arabic reads 'التقييم البيئي' as 'التقييم البيني' in the title and in many places). Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr (portal has French and Arabic only) and environnement.gov.mr (lois page lists French documents only).

title: Loi n°2000-045 du 26 juillet 2000 portant Code de l'environnement
citation: Loi n° 2000-045 du 26 juillet 2000 portant Code de l'environnement, Journal Officiel n° 985 (2000)
evidence: No in-force date read: the gazette issue https://msgg.gov.mr/JO/2000/mauritanie-jo-2000-985.pdf (opened 2026-11-03) is a scanned image with no text layer, and the portal list gives the adoption date only ("Loi n°2000-045 du 26 juillet 2000").
notes: One record, French (fr): the gazette issue is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext returns 24 characters for the whole file), so the record is OCR. The French text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack fra from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 6 to 20, from the title line 'Loi N° 2000 - 045 ... PORTANT CODE DE L'ENVIRONNEMENT' to the Prime Minister's signature after Art. 100; the title line itself is read 'pu 26 JUILLET'. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. Repealed in part or whole: Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019 (mr-loi-2025-019) repeals contrary provisions of earlier law 'notamment' this code; the text does not say which articles survive, so the extent is not stated. The Ministry of the Environment lists the code as a PDF at http://www.environnement.gov.mr/fr/images/reglementations/LOI_Code_de_l_Environnement.pdf (not used, no licence row for that host). Arabic gazette issue: https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2000/mauritanie-jo-2000-985-ar.pdf (also scanned): not stored, because the PDF the portal serves skips gazette pages 582 and 586 (it runs 581, 583, 584, 585, 587, 588), so the articles on those pages (about Arts. 39 to 48 and 79 to 91) are not in it and a partial text would read as the whole law; the Arabic edition stays link only. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr and environnement.gov.mr.
status_note: Repealed 'notamment' by Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019; the portal list shows no repeal annotation on this entry on 2026-11-03.

title: Décret n°2004-094 du 4 novembre 2004 relatif à l'étude d'impact sur l'environnement
citation: Décret n° 2004-094 du 4 novembre 2004 relatif à l'étude d'impact sur l'environnement, Journal Officiel n° 1095 (2005)
evidence: No in-force date read: the gazette issue https://msgg.gov.mr/JO/2005/mauritanie-jo-2005-1095.pdf (opened 2026-11-03) is a scanned image with no text layer. Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019 says the decree 'restent en vigueur en attendant l'adoption du décret portant application de la présente loi'.
notes: Two records (fr, ar): the French gazette issue is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext returns 20 characters for the whole file), so both records are OCR. The French text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack fra from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 4 to 9, from the heading 'Décret n° 2004 - 094' to the last article (Art. 36). Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. The Arabic text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack ara from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 4 to 9 of https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2005/mauritanie-jo-2005-1095-ar.pdf, from the heading to Art. 36. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read; the Arabic scan has three landscape pages, turned upright with the orientation tesseract reports before reading. The printed heading in both editions reads 'du 24 novembre 2004' (read from the page image), while this entry and the portal list say 4 novembre 2004; the title is not changed here. Still in force on 2026-11-03 under Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019, as amended by Décret n° 2007-105 (mr-decret-2007-105). The Loi n° 2025-019 text calls the date 'du 04 novembre 2004'; the portal list writes 4 novembre 2004. The Ministry of the Environment lists a PDF of the decree (http://www.environnement.gov.mr/fr/images/reglementations/DECRET_N_2004_Etudes_d_Impact_sur_l_Environnement.pdf), not used. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr and environnement.gov.mr.

title: Décret n°2007-105 du 13 avril 2007 modifiant et complétant certaines dispositions du décret n°2004-094 relatif à l'étude d'impact sur l'environnement
citation: Décret n° 2007-105 du 13 avril 2007, Journal Officiel n° 1145 (2007)
evidence: No in-force date read: the gazette issue https://msgg.gov.mr/JO/2007/mauritanie-jo-2007-1145.pdf (opened 2026-11-03) is a scanned image with no text layer. Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019 names the decree as 'décret n°2007-105 du 13 avril 2007' and keeps it in force.
notes: Two records (fr, ar): the French gazette issue is a scanned image with no text layer (pdftotext returns 52 characters for the whole file), so both records are OCR. The French text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack fra from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 37 to 43, from the heading 'Décret n° 2007 - 105' to Art. 3 (execution clause); the scan is clipped at the page edges, so some words are cut and stay cut. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. The Arabic text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack ara from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 31 to 36 of https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2007/mauritanie-jo-2007-1145-ar.pdf, from the heading to Art. 3. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. Annexe I and Annexe II (tables of works and activities by category) follow Art. 3 and are not in the records: read as column crops a table comes out in the wrong order, so the annexes stay in the PDF only. The portal list titles it 'du 13 avril 2004', which cannot be right for a decree numbered 2007 amending a decree of November 2004; the title here follows Art. 44 of Loi n° 2025-019 (13 avril 2007). No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr and environnement.gov.mr.

title: Loi n°2020-007 du 4 juin 2020 relative à la protection du consommateur
citation: Loi n° 2020-007 du 4 juin 2020 relative à la protection du consommateur, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1465 du 15 juillet 2020, p. 480
evidence: Art. 91: "La présente loi prend effet à partir de 6 mois de sa date de publication." The portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2020-1465 du 15/07/2020" (https://msgg.gov.mr/fr/droit-mauritanien/le-journal-officiel.html, opened 2026-11-03), so six months from publication is 2021-01-15 (the date is computed here, not printed on any page).
notes: Umbrella consumer law for goods and services (information, abusive practices, associations); a search of the stored text for 'environnement', 'allégation', 'mensonger' and 'trompeur' found no provision on environmental claims, so it is the umbrella only. Implemented in part by mr-decret-2024-027. Two records (fr, ar): French text of the gazette issue (two column crops per page, running headers and bare page numbers dropped). Arabic (the official language): the Arabic gazette issue is served at https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2020/mauritanie-jo-2020-1465-ar.pdf. The Arabic text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack ara from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 4 to 11, from the title of the law to the last signature line. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr (French and Arabic only).

title: Décret n°2024-027 du 20 février 2024 fixant les conditions et modalités d'agrément des associations de défense des consommateurs
citation: Décret n° 2024-027 du 20 février 2024, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1559 du 15 juin 2024, p. 480
evidence: No official page states an entry-into-force date: Art. 12 says the decree 'sera publié au Journal Officiel' and Art. 10 refers to 'son entrée en vigueur' without a date. The portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2024-1559 du 15/06/2024" (opened 2026-11-03); the record is dated that gazette date, not a stated entry into force.
notes: Implements Art. 74 of Loi n° 2020-007 (mr-loi-2020-007) and repeals Décret n° 2003-030; it governs approval of consumer associations, not environmental claims. Two records (fr, ar): French text. Arabic (the official language): the Arabic gazette issue is served at https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2024/mauritanie-jo-2024-1559-ar.pdf. The Arabic text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack ara from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 25 to 26, from the title of the decree to the last signature line. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr (French and Arabic only).

title: Loi n°2018-017 du 13 mars 2018 relative à la publicité
citation: Loi n° 2018-017 du 13 mars 2018 relative à la publicité, Journal Officiel de la République Islamique de Mauritanie n° 1410 du 15 avril 2018
evidence: No in-force date read: the gazette text was not stored (see notes). The portal lists the gazette as "Journal officiel n°2018-1410 du 15/04/2018" (opened 2026-11-03).
notes: Advertising law with a ban on misleading advertising ('publicité mensongère ou trompeuse') and on advertising for products harmful to the environment; it is the nearest Mauritanian rule to a green-claims duty. Two records (fr, ar): the earlier pdftotext attempts failed on the text layer (scrambled article order), so both records are OCR of the page images instead, in which the article numbers run to Art. 246 (in order in the French; the Arabic OCR misreads some of them). The French text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack fra from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 2 to 29, from the title line 'Loi n°2018-017 relative à la publicité' to the last signature line. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. The Arabic text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (tesseract 5.3.4, language pack ara from tessdata 4.1.0, pdftoppm -r 200, page images read as left and right column crops with the running header cropped away; the PDF's own text layer is not used): PDF pages 3 to 24 of https://msgg.gov.mr/JO-AR/2018/mauritanie-jo-2018-1410-ar.pdf, from the title line to the last signature line. Only whole lines were dropped (bare page numbers and lines of neighbouring items); no character was corrected, so misreads stay as read. No government English text found: looked for on msgg.gov.mr.
